name: Devansh Gupte
headline: WordPress sites your team can edit without calling me.
intro: I'm Devansh, a WordPress developer. I build custom themes, Gutenberg blocks and WooCommerce stores that load fast and are easy to manage.
about:
I build WordPress sites for small businesses, startups and agencies. Most of my work is custom themes and WooCommerce stores, plus the plugins and blocks that tie them together.

What I care about most is the handover. A site isn't finished when it launches: it's finished when the owner can update it without help. So I build with native blocks, keep plugins to a minimum and leave clear documentation.
